UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Complete user profile, settings, and Second Brain workspace entities for BlueNote stored as native Firestore Maps and Lists

workspace.description: Native Map containing user tasks, notes, folders, projects, events, reminders, contacts, links, files, shoppingLists, habits, goals, inbox, knowledgeGraph, automations, conversations, activityLog, savedSearches, and settings

/workspaces/{userId}.description: User-owned workspace document isolated strictly to the authenticated owner.
